scope: Focused SR observation confound calibration using actual Allen and FASTIMAGES data; no claim of learned SR in either dataset.
Allen_primary: Response window 50..250 ms; no prestimulus duplication result reused as new. 118 images plus blank retained in predictors; original conservative union invalid mask. VISp primary, all visual secondary with same event mask. Four chronological held-out groups; remove 3 event guard at each discontinuity/fold boundary for all compared models.
Allen_models: F1: current + 1 future image negative control
Allen_metric: Nested leave-chronological-group-out ridge regression; common inner alpha grid per model, standardized predictors/response only from training observations. Outer held-out SSE relative to train-mean baseline; report all four folds and ROI aggregate. Not participant-level inference.
Allen_mechanistic_limit: Stimulus-specific independent history coefficients are not assumed to be scalar multiples of a common B; exact SR alias only follows under that additional separability restriction. Fixed-SOA FIR full raw analyses need design rank audit.
FAST_primary: Use author-cleaned 102 magnetometers and actual event onsets; localizer-trained causal sensor-by-stimulus response kernel with finite support; cross-held-block generalization to sequences. No extra probability simplex normalization.
FAST_limit: Rapid physical future items can occur inside nominal post-cue windows; physiological impulse responses and task prediction cannot be separated by SR template competition alone unless measured sensory history included. Shared localized reference is estimated from training blocks only.
parameter_selection: Any data-informed or post-primary extension explicitly marked. This is retrospective computational analysis of previously accessed recordings, not preregistration.
uncertainty: Within-session cross-validation provides repeatable prediction evidence; no deterministic confidence certificate and no population inference from single mouse/person.
